verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs describe off-cycle payrolls that run outside the regular schedule for corrections and special bonuses. They include an off_cycle_reason of Bonus with its own withholding and deduction defaults, and the platform overview lists termination processing alongside off-cycle payments. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that termination pay is run as an off-cycle payroll, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run an off-cycle payroll for bonuses, corrections, or terminations outside the regular schedule

citations.quote: Off-cycle payrolls handle one-off situations like corrections or special bonuses. They use the same withholding rates, deductions, and contributions as regular payrolls, but aren't tied to the regular schedule.
One-off (or 'off-cycle') payrolls are available if you need to pay your team outside of the regular payroll schedule.
All benefits and deductions are default blocked and the payroll is default taxed at a fixed withholding rate when the off_cycle_reason is set to Bonus.
Handle all aspects of payroll management including regular payroll runs, off-cycle payments, termination processing, and all associated federal, state, and local filings and payments.
